name: serpapi_google_trending_now
description: Get Google's current Trending Now feed through SerpApi without a seed topic. Use for 'what is trending now?', 'latest trends on Google', 'what is trending today?', 'show current search trends', or 'breaking topics in the US'. The trending_now action returns ranked trends by country and a 4/24/48/168-hour window with volume, growth, active state, categories, related searches, Google Trends links, and a news_page_token. It cannot filter by topic; if explicitly selected alongside a topic, run it and explain that scope rather than substitute another tool. Use news with an exact returned token for one trend's articles; it never runs automatically. Use serpapi_google_trends for topic-specific analysis when this tool was not explicitly selected.

action.description: trending_now discovers current trends and is the default. news retrieves articles for one news_page_token returned by an earlier trending_now result.

geo.description: Two-letter supported Trending Now country code. Default US. Used only by trending_now.

hours.description: How far back to discover trends: 4, 24, 48, or 168 hours. Default 24. Used only by trending_now.

category_id.description: Optional official Trending Now category ID. Examples: 3 business/finance, 7 health, 14 politics, 17 sports, 18 technology, 19 travel, 20 climate.

only_active.description: Return only trends that are currently active. Default false. Used only by trending_now.

language.description: Optional two-letter interface language such as en or es. Used only by trending_now.

page_token.description: Exact news_page_token from a trending_now result. Required only for action=news; do not invent or alter it.

trend_query.description: Optional label for the selected trend when action=news. It improves output/UI context and is not sent to SerpApi.

max_results.description: Maximum normalized trends or news articles returned. Default 20; maximum 50.

max_breakdown_queries.description: Maximum related searches retained per trend. Default 10. Set 0 to omit them.

no_cache.description: Bypass SerpApi's one-hour exact-parameter cache. Default false; cached searches are free.

extra_params.description: Advanced non-reserved parameters passed to SerpApi. Engine, location, time, category, activity, language, token, cache, async, and output controls cannot be overridden.

include_raw.description: Include the full SerpApi response for debugging or dataset capture. Default false.

availability.setup_hint: Set SERP_API_KEY in the active mode env file.
